programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: Paradisiacal seas, reefs and exquisite sandy beaches: the Bermuda islands are the most northerly of all the Caribbean islands. Since the 17th century, the islands have belong to the British Crown. Then and today, they represent a vital bridgehead into America. Here, the Queen still reigns – with pomp and splendour.

programme.desc: Cross-border Firefighting equipment donations and training efforts

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Laos is a small, landlocked and sparsely populated country in Southeast Asia and therein lies the charm. Surrounded by larger, more populous nations like Vietnam, Thailand & China, Laos is a haven without the swarming throngs of tourists. The relaxed, laid back but friendly nature of the Lao people is infectious and as more and more savvy travelers are finding, is helping Laos become one the loveliest hidden gems in all of Asia.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we sail all the way to southern Turkey to visit the picturesque village of Kaleköy in the Kekova area. We introduce you to a local family who run the Likya restaurant, and serve simple delicious Turkish food. We’ve known them for over 30 years, ever since we began sailing here. We also discover how the locals love the carob bean, and how they make a tasty, healthy syrup from it. Finally, we’ll introduce you to our friend Kadriye who cooks up a typical Turkish lunch, and one of her neighbours demonstrates how to make the local pancake called gözleme.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Travel Thru History is a unique, Emmy nominated travel series that explores diverse cities and historical sites around the World while experiencing the cultural and archaeological features of these unique locations. From the oldest building in the Western Hemisphere to the famous French Quarter, a spectacular chain of islands off the Southern coast of Florida to the birthplace of California, the Travel Thru History series is a must see to learn about America's rich and fascinating history by traveling to amazing cities across the states. It explores diverse cities and historical sites while experiencing the cultural and archaeological features of these unique locations.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Adventure All Stars is the world’s only socially conscious travel show – an inspiring series that combines adventure and philanthropy. Cast members travel to secret locations, to uncover the best and most exciting experiences on the planet! Pre-filming all cast members raise funds for their favorite charitable cause, and their reward is the trip-of-a-lifetime. The show contributes more to charity than any other Australian television series, and is now one of the biggest donors to philanthropy of any TV show in the world (almost $10 Million).

programme.title: The Colours of China
programme.desc: Five colours are an integral part of contemporary China and the ancient philosophy of Wu Xing. Each episode takes us to regions where we meet our characters, learn how Wu Xing sits in their lives and explore the landscapes they live in.

programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Plum and the team are joined by Chef Adam Bedini as they head out to the countryside to visit Peter Fay and Mohawk Bison in Goshen, CT. programme.title: Expedia Presents
programme.desc: Come along as American Olympic champion, Kelsey Robinson Cook, returns to Turkiye to rediscover a country she deeply loves for its unique culture, food, natural wonders, and adventure. First, Kelsey and Alexa dive back into old rhythms in Istanbul-it's all baklava bites, bazaar strolls, and sunsets stitched with laughter. Then, adventure takes flight in Cappadocia. Restless for wonder, Kelsey trades the city's pulse for wild tracks and landscapes carved from dreams. And finally, a final splash in bucket-list Bodrum: waves, laughter, and golden skies close out Kelsey and Alexa's unforgettable Turkish journey.
